units.source_text: 到了四月里，明石道人为源氏公子置办夏衣，以及夏令用的帐幕垂布，都富有雅趣。

en.t: When April came, the Akashi monk prepared summer robes for Prince Genji, as well as curtains and hanging draperies for the season, all chosen with elegant taste.

units.source_text: 明石道人照料源氏公子，如此诚恳周到，公子觉得不好意思，并且认为太过分了。

en.t: The Akashi monk cared for Prince Genji with such sincerity and attention that the prince felt embarrassed and thought it was almost too much.

units.source_text: 但念这位道人人品优越，身份高贵，也就老实不客气地生受了。

en.t: But remembering that this monk was a man of excellent character and noble standing, he accepted the kindness frankly and without further ceremony.

units.source_text: 京中也常常有人送物品来。

en.t: People in the capital also often sent things to him.
